subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw approve a smaller Channel Broker SDK/bundled-plugin boundary for a Phase 2A conformance harness, or should shared channel conformance stay on the existing `channel-outbound` contract?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested broker surface, and the previous broad implementation was closed unmerged because it crossed channel, plugin SDK, runtime, config, and security boundaries without prior design approval.

options.title: Require smaller broker design first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-approved design narrows the SDK, plugin, config, migration, and security boundary before implementation resumes.

options.title: Use channel-outbound instead
options.body: Close or retarget this issue to extend the existing channel-outbound conformance helpers rather than adding a separate broker layer.

options.title: Sponsor broker implementation now
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly approve the broker direction and request a new focused PR that avoids the closed stack’s broad cross-boundary changes.

recommendation.title: Require smaller broker design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-approved design narrows the SDK, plugin, config, migration, and security boundary before implementation resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: This account posted the linked stack close decision and is the clearest current owner for whether a smaller broker boundary should be reconsidered.
